topic: Uv 0.12.0: Astral's Python Package Manager Gets Faster and Smarter

key_points: Breaking changes in uv init: now defaults to src/ layout with uv_build backend
uv init now creates a packaged project with [build-system] and [project.scripts] entry
Simon notes he's avoided src layout out of inertia but thinks it's time to switch
Questions when uv will hit 1.0 release
Comprehensive tutorial covering uv as pip/pyenv/poetry/pipx replacement
Benchmarks: installing 23 packages takes pip 6.6s vs uv 0.15s on warm cache
Covers pip compatibility mode, lock files, CI/CD, PEP 723 scripts
Published May 9, 2026
Official release notes published July 28, 2026
Major breaking changes: uv init now defaults to src/ layout with uv_build
Rejects unsupported archive formats (.tar.bz2, .tar.xz) per PEP 625
Security: rejects wheel files that could replace Python interpreter
Pre-release handling improved: if-necessary mode replaces if-necessary-or-explicit
Respects --require-hashes in requirements.txt, rejects MD5-only hashes
pylock.toml validation: requires packages array, validates filenames and sizes
SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR now honored strictly
New --cert flag for uv pip commands
Project discovery now relative to script path in uv run
uv venv --clear requires --force for non-virtualenv directories
Automatic open-file limit adjustment on Unix (stabilized)
TOML 1.0-compatible source distributions (stabilized)
uv upgrade can target multiple packages
uv 0.12.0 published July 28, 2026 on PyPI
An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust
Replaces pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, virtualenv
Official Astral documentation for uv installation
Multiple install methods: curl, pip, pipx, cargo, brew
Cross-platform support: macOS, Linux, Windows

stats.fact: uv has 88,036 stars on GitHub as of July 2026
uv is 10-100x faster than pip in benchmarks
Installing 23 packages: pip takes 6.6s vs uv takes 0.15s on warm cache
uv is written in Rust and created by Astral (the company behind Ruff)
uv was first released on October 2, 2023
uv replaces pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, and virtualenv in one tool
uv 0.12.0 has 14+ breaking changes focused on correctness, safety, and spec compliance
uv now automatically adjusts open-file limits on Linux/macOS (capped at 1,048,576)

angles: uv 0.12.0 is a maturity milestone — moving from 'fast experiment' toward production-grade package management with strict spec compliance
The src/ layout default signals Astral's confidence in uv_build as a stable build backend
Security focus in 0.12.0: interpreter hijacking prevention, hash validation, SSL cert handling — uv is being hardened for enterprise use
The breaking changes are mostly safety improvements that won't affect most users, making this a low-friction upgrade
uv is approaching 1.0 territory — the question is when, not if
88k GitHub stars shows uv has surpassed poetry in community adoption
The pre-release handling change (if-necessary) brings uv closer to pip behavior while being smarter
